title: An annotated test-bed registry and leakage-corrected evaluation protocol for lunar void-candidate inference from meter-scale orbital terrain data

description: An annotated test-bed registry and leakage-corrected evaluation protocol for lunar void-candidate inference from meter-scale orbital terrain data, provided as a community-testable evaluation resource rather than a survey catalogue. The registry annotates 278 candidate rows across 21 LROC NAC digital terrain models (24,062.96 km2, calibration-context pit-associated sites), including explicit duplicate-supersession links (161 SUPERSEDED rows; 117 unique features), row-level TP/FP/ring/funnel labels, and 233 explicitly not-inferable below-floor rows; both row-based (3.74 [1.71, 7.10] per 10^4 km2) and unique-feature (2.08 [0.67, 4.85]) false-positive rates are reported as calibration-context rates, never survey rates. The evaluation protocol closes the two leakage paths that inflated an earlier random-split baseline (duplicate features spanning train/test splits and shared-DTM correlation), demonstrated with a leave-one-DTM-out PU-learning baseline (pooled out-of-fold F1 0.824, AUC 0.930). The release bundles the annotated registry, methods and provenance documentation, the evaluation-protocol scripts, and frozen summary statistics. Underlying LROC NAC DTMs and the lunar pit atlas are NASA PDS public-domain products, are not redistributed here, and all registry rows are calibrated inferences, never detections.
